data.title: 宝多六花 · 防波堤台阶上的汽水气泡
data.action: 随性地坐在防波堤水泥阶梯上，一件宽松针织衫滑落半边香肩，露出的匀称双腿随性弯曲，一手握着刚拉开拉环的冰镇汽水，略带困惑却眼神温柔地侧目看过来
data.location: 沿海小镇空旷的临海防波堤石阶
data.lighting: 泛紫黄昏晚霞与沿海路灯初上的暖黄点光
data.camera: 自然生活化中景，注重捕捉肉感身材曲线与写实青春氛围
data.mood: 慵懒青春、自然随性、微妙悸动
data.description: 海滨小镇渐入黄昏的防波堤。宝多六花将宽松的米色薄针织开衫套在极简哑光黑分体泳衣外，单肩微微滑落。她随性屈膝坐在水泥台阶上，手里握着刚拉开的汽水罐，侧头向你投来带着一丝困惑与青春期特有温柔的目光，海风吹起鬓角的发丝，满是夏末的心动日常。
promptTokens: slouchy oversized cream summer knit cardigan slipping off one shoulder
sitting relaxed on seaside concrete barrier stairs
holding cold can of soda with condensation
twilight purple sky and distant ocean
data.promptProse: Rikka Takarada sitting casually on the steps of a concrete seawall overlooking an evening ocean. Over a minimalist sporty black bikini, she wears a loose, slouchy cream-colored knit cardigan slipping off one shoulder. Resting her cheek toward the breeze while holding a chilled aluminum soda can, her expressive blue eyes meet the viewer's with an effortless blend of relaxed warmth and modern teenage realism.
